name: Loop of 2 hours from Hörby without side loops
description: From a real test (2026-09-26): a 2-hour loop from Hörby turned off into Röstånga, rode south through the town's streets to its waypoint on road 13, circled a block and came back up to the crossing it had already passed. A loop's length is a guide; such a detour only makes up length. The standard set from Hörby had side loops of up to 4.4 km.
